steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahhh! We're flipping! We're gonna flip over!!!!
[CG - Car Chase A]
The shabby dune buggy bursts out, bouncing a few times on the ground before finally stabilizing. Hella is sitting in the driver's seat, scared but safe.
Korryn tries to lean out and shoot but nearly gets hit by bullets from behind.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: ...Tsk, can't hit 'em. Need a better position...

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Haha! Give it up now!
Another wave of gunfire crackles. The shabby little buggy speeds along the transport route, trailed by shrieking desert bandits.
Holding down her hat with one hand, Korryn finally gets a chance to glance back at the trembling Hella.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Steering wheel... gas pedal... gears... wait, which one's the brake?!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Oh, it's simple. Hold the wheel tight and floor the gas—the brake? What of it? You won't need it.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So why am I the one driving ahhhhh...!
She steps down on the gas pedal all the way, pushing the vehicle to its limits, but the bandits are still closing in.
Misfortunes always come in a bundle. A flash appears in the rearview mirror—a gleaming cannon barrel is aimed right at the little shabby buggy!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Little Hella, get ready. We're gonna jump out of the car.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Now!
Korryn grabs the steering wheel, slams it to the left, and the car instantly veers off course.
The rifle muzzle flares, and traces of Mania crawl up the shooter's face. The Sinner shooter spins around and fires—the bullet hits the engine of the vehicle behind.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Bullseye.
The next second, flames shoot skyward. The two are blown away by the explosion's shockwave, landing in the sand below the cliff.
[White]
The wind sweeps across the sand. The entire area is deserted.
Half a ruined car frame tilts on the sand. Parts and metal scraps are scattered everywhere, while the near totaled engine emits a puff of black smoke.
Rustle... rustle...
A green lizard scurries across the sand, leaving a trail of tiny footprints. It carefully circles the ground and finally finds a softer patch of sand, patting it gently with its claws.
Puff! A hand bursts through the sand. Korryn crawls out, pulling out a coughing Hella with her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Cough, cough, cough... pfft, pfft!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Little Hella... Hey, snap out of it! Still alive?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Still mad? Oh, come on, you did great. Here, if it helps, you can pinch my left cheek to let off some steam...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Please be gentle. My skin's delicate. I can't take too much pain.
Korryn actually leans her face closer, only to find Hella looking up with shining eyes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That was awesome!!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Didn't expect driving to be this fun! Is bounty hunting always this thrilling? I had a blast!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I really wish that dummy and Hecate were here to see this. When we were retreating, they wouldn't let me touch the wheel. But look at me now, ${PlayerName}! I'm a fantastic driver.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: ${PlayerName}? Hmm... That name sounds familiar...
Korryn seems to ponder something. Hella quickly waves her hand to change the subject.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh, and that shot of yours! The last one, bang—it made the desert bandits bite the dust! So cool!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Can you teach me? I want to be a badass like you. This is why I left the city!
Hella wields her pipe like a gun, striking a cool shooting pose. Korryn bursts into laughter.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Pfft, hahaha!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What's so funny? I'm serious! You saw how I helped earlier, right? Even though I didn't know how to drive, I took you on a wild ride. I'm quick learner! Pleeeeease teach me~

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: After what we've been through together, we are now kind of, you know... partners, right?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Of course, I'm delighted to meet a "partner" like you. But...
The wind suddenly picks up. As the blazing sun starts to set, the wind in WhiteSands gradually turns cold. Hella gets hit by the chill and sneezes hard.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: See, the wind in WhiteSands is deadly. After a whole day of adventure, the heroes need to find a place to rest.
Korryn checks the sun to determine the direction and makes a decision.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: We're not far from the old route. There's a place nearby where we can stay. The town's small, but we will probably be able to get a new car.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: So, can you still walk?
After a long, bumpy journey, Hella finally sees her destination before her legs give out.
It's really small town, nestled in the lee of a massive wall of sand. The buildings are old and look like they'll soon be swallowed up by the sand.
A wooden sign hangs over the town's gate—if that shaky frame can even be called one. Looking up, Hella sees a few big letters carved on it. It's a really simple word, even Hella can read it out.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ..."Tuco"?
